Ripstop nylon shell handles light rain and trail brush, though it's water-resistant, not waterproof — if you're heading into sustained downpour country, pack a liner.

45 liters fits a solid 2–4 night kit without forcing you to choose between your sleeping pad and your camp stove.

For the next little while, it's 10% off. No countdown clock, just a straightforward discount while it lasts.
